hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Northern Africa, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Egypt, Tunisia, and Algeria || mostly barren, flat to undulating plains, plateaus, depressions || more than 90% of the country is desert or semidesert the volcano Waw an Namus lies in south central Libya in the middle of the Sahara; the caldera is an oasis -- the name means "oasis of mosquitoes" -- containing several small lakes that host many species of insects and birds || Resources: petroleum, natural gas, gypsum || Exports: crude petroleum, natural gas, refined petroleum, gold, scrap iron (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly barren, flat to undulating plains, plateaus, depressions || Northern Africa, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Egypt, Tunisia, and Algeria

climate.excerpt: Mediterranean along coast; dry, extreme desert interior || hot, dry, dust-laden ghibli is a southern wind lasting one to four days in spring and fall; dust storms, sandstorms

economy.excerpt: upper middle-income, fossil fuel-based North African economy; 31% economic contraction due to COVID-19 and 2020 oil blockade; reduced government spending; central bank had to devalue currency; public wages are over 60% of expenditures || Exports: crude petroleum, natural gas, refined petroleum, gold, scrap iron (2023) || Industries: petroleum, petrochemicals, aluminum, iron and steel, food processing, textiles, handicrafts, cement

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: Muslim (official; virtually all Sunni) 96.6%, Christian 2.7%, Buddhist <1%, Hindu <1%, Jewish <1%, folk religion <1%, other <1%, unaffiliated <1% (2020 est.) || Amazigh and Arab 97%, other 3% (includes Egyptian, Greek, Indian, Italian, Maltese, Pakistani, Tunisian, and Turkish)
